apps.name: OneShot
apps.description: A pleasing screenshot tool and image viewer. Grab an area, a window or the whole screen, then annotate with arrows, text, counters, highlights and pixelation. Pin captures on top, drag them straight into any app, and browse folders of images with a fast viewer.

apps.name: Clockodile
apps.tagline: Track time, bill clients, export clean PDF timesheets.
apps.description: A calm, fast time tracker that lives in your menu bar. Start a timer or log time in one line ("Design review 1h30 @acme #meeting"), see your week at a glance, mark entries as billed or paid, and export polished PDF timesheets or CSV. Idle detection, rates per client and project, rounding, and all data stays on your computer.

apps.name: YapTap
apps.tagline: Hold a key, talk, let go. Fully local dictation.
apps.description: Free, open-source dictation that runs entirely on your computer. Hold a key, speak, and clean text appears wherever your cursor is. Speech recognition runs locally with NVIDIA Parakeet or OpenAI Whisper: no cloud, no account, no word limits.
highlights: Hold or tap to dictate in any app
